english.note: Use 頁 for a physical page or one side of a leaf in a book or document.
Use this for a numbered page or sheet side, especially when counting how many pages an essay has.

examples.jyutping: cing2 nei5 tai2 dai6 sap6 jip6

examples.english: My essay is five pages long, counting each side.
examples.traditional: 我篇文有五頁，計埋每一面。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 pin1 man4 jau5 ng5 jip6 gai3 maai4 mui5 jat1 min6
